findings.detail: Revised positive wording explicitly preserves laboratory scope, exclusive time eligibility, allowance ceiling/calendar year, and refund trigger; the Rowan questions now request only the normal deadline.

The four incorrect or wrong-topic substantive responses now use actual_behavior answer. Correctness and topical failures remain in their own dimensions and the derived response-behavior requirement, rather than being disguised as partial response form.

All three review probes seed genuine semantic errors. Their expected_disputes sets are justified independently by raw answer/evidence. Exact spans and schema consistency cannot rescue false entailment or omitted claims.

Approval applies only to authored expectations for these byte-hashed development suites. It is not a semantic-model run, human adjudication, authorization verification, or sealed-holdout/generalization result.

limitations: Only the two new suites and current evaluator contract were read for this review; prior review context remained in the same validator task.
No separate authorship notes, previous evaluation reports, holdouts, fixture tests, APIs, application runtime, or git operations were used.

The six assessment dimensions plus overall and actual_behavior were reviewed semantically; live evaluator agreement remains unmeasured.
